morning.purpose: Overnight developments, the economic calendar, market expectations, and material premarket news.

afternoon.purpose: Closing performance, releases, policy decisions, earnings trends, and geopolitical developments.
afternoon.revision_policy: Revise the morning edition; retain a still-important morning story unless a newer candidate is at least 10 points more significant.

publication_rule: Only verified candidates may be selected. Fewer than six verified, distinct candidates stops the refresh and leaves the last verified edition unchanged.
